title: Crochet Mouse
description: A pocket-sized amigurumi mouse with a simple body and tiny ears.
expectationText: A small toy that keeps the shaping simple so you can focus on round structure, neat decreases, and attaching tiny features cleanly.

steps.title: Start the body
steps.instruction: Make a magic ring and mark the first stitch.

steps.title: Round 1
steps.instruction: Work 6 single crochet into the ring.

steps.title: Increase
steps.instruction: Increase evenly until the body reaches the desired width.

steps.title: Work even
steps.instruction: Crochet several rounds without increasing to build the body length.

steps.title: Decrease and stuff
steps.instruction: Stuff the mouse and decrease toward the tail end until nearly closed.

steps.title: Add ears and tail
steps.instruction: Sew on two tiny ears and attach a chain or yarn tail.
